mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM resource_report WHERE status = 'PENDING'

SELECT r.id, r.title, r.category_id, c.name AS category_name, r.description, r.file_url, r.owner_id, r.owner_name, r.like_count, r.download_count, r.view_count, r.allow_download, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM resource r LEFT JOIN resource_category c ON r.category_id = c.id ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
